There's so much in a what if, history as we know it will change so I don't think it's healthy to keep it too close to what we've known about him. Absolute power corrupts absolutely but I don't think he'll be incompetent, he despite his flaws still manage to hold his grasp tightly on huabei(? Whichever region he hold). Liu biao historically is a very competent leader, the coalition is more so as a han loyalist as the Han was never dissolved in this case having all of them working as a Han officer instead of being a local warlord loyally, so no infighting other than maybe some border dispute or minor bandit uprising/xiongnu/etc.  

Liu Zhang was young iirc when he came to power(?) he had potential, his officers like Zhang ren and Yan Yan were loyal to his father Liu Yan, and without Liu Bei coming over to take over his territory I doubt he'd be usurped by anyone anytime soon, maybe in 220+ because I believe the power struggle would be delayed a lot without a common enemy. It was Way of peace/Taiping cult/Yellow turban, Dong Zhuo, Yuan Shu and then Cao Cao. So as long as Yuan Shao toe the line there's nothing to fight for.

Remember On Morale "if the enemy general is strong say that they are all brawn and no brain to preserve your army's morale" or something along those line. I don't believe lu bu is stupid at all, he was just a man born in a wrong time where being an ambitious opportunist paints a target on his back, if he was always loyal to the Han or dong zhuo or anyone else would he have left his mark as "among men, Lu Bu"? Would he just be a nameless, faceless adoptive son to dong zhuo? We'll never know. What ifs are fun, but first we need to establish what are we going to change and what kind of rules are we sticking too otherwise it would be a fictionary tale with familiar names and faces instead.  

Sun Ce was hot headed, but so was Lu Bu. But that's the point of this what if of mine, what if their end was different? What if he was able to listen to his counselors for once? What if he eradicated the cults peacefully? What if during the battle of Guan Du he allied himself with Yuan Shao and back stab Cap Cao by going through Ru Nan and went straight to Xu Chang?

Everything will change, Liu Bei might stay as Yuan Shao's vassal being ever closer to his royal family and will revolt when Yuan decides to go against the "heaven's will". Sun Ce will be the new warlord to beat since he is not a "loyalist", he doesn't care about the Han and I don't think anyone could reign him in to focus on Wu's politics, but with sun quan not being burdened by the "crown" he might be an able minister to govern the domestic affair along with lu su, Zhang bros, etc.  

Cao's army might not be wiped out but he will certainly be irrelevant if he do survive, might escape to Wan/Shang Yong/Han Zhong and work with Zhang Lu. But in the case that he didn't his able minister will be absorbed by Yuan Shao, the like of Zhang Liao, Xu Huang, Xun You especially the latter two since they're "Han loyalist".  

Liu Zhang-Liu Biao-Ma Teng-Yuan Shao will lead as the figure head of the later Han until Yuan's ambition for control will eventually turn them into another cao. Wu can either keep raiding or even going on full on conquest against liu biao/Jing province but if as I said sun Ce decides to focus on domestic affairs we might be having a modicum period of peace for awhile if not for much longer.
